description: A long yellow mancala board with small round cups holding blue, green, and clear glass stones sits on a red bedspread near a white pillow. The right hand hovers over the board, then reaches down to pinch a few stones from a cup near the middle, lifts them, and moves upward toward the top row to drop them into successive cups, continuing the sowing motion along the row; the mancala board is the right-hand object throughout.
